source: Independent source-informed focus eligibility, composed-tree traversal and ordering implementation. Declarations and selected tests/HTML fixtures retain MIT attribution. No upstream runtime is included; this is not a clean-room claim.

implementation.targetScope: Focus candidate and tab ordering APIs used by Floating UI's popover, dropdown and tooltip interaction layer.

changes: Radio groups compare names as data and share one traversal-local lookup by root and actual form owner, including externally associated radios.
Inert inheritance crosses shadow roots and assigned slots; boolean attribute presence is respected.
Nested disabled-fieldset first-legend exemptions are evaluated per ancestor.
No DOM globals are captured at module import; traversal and ordering use explicit frames.

verification.runtime: Ten unchanged upstream unit tests, six focused controls including actual Floating UI 0.27.20 focus-manager consumption, and an SSR/module regression pass on Node 24 and Bun.
verification.browser: 1,080 Chrome fixture comparisons and six focused checks. The original inert-shadow fixture differences are explicitly isolated and checked against native focus behavior.
verification.distribution: Packed npm/Bun installation, CJS/ESM, browser bundling and TypeScript 7 consumers.
verification.limits: Not the full Cypress suite or Safari/Firefox certification. Benchmarks use jsdom with fixed visible styles on both runtimes, excluding CSS resolution, layout and rendering. The original jsdom style workload stalled on Bun with both implementations; Chrome tests cover actual style behavior.
